author: Half-Right
body:
It is a slog, but still fun. I find the advancement rate to be fairly constant even though the XP Halfway Point is not until you're halfway through Level 241 :D

I'd suggest that regardless of content/gameplay style, you'll want to Godforge [XP & Orn gear](https://www.ornalegends.com/home/how-to-get-more-orns-and-experience-in-orna) such as Trialing weapons, Court Jester's Outfit, Mightiest Mimic Head, and of course Bands of God. With all of that stuff maxed, even just clearing mobs at home can net many Billions of XP per hour (with Affinity Candle, EXP Potion, Coins, Vulcan's Brew, and ideally Shrine of Wisdom running). 

You'll also want to be building up your Anguish and Ascension levels as you level up, as best you can. 

Once you do the above, then whether you hit Towers, Monuments, Dungeons, or just regular overworld mobs, you'll level up steadily. 

Raids do give good XP, but gear and Anguish don't matter, so I'd say save your Summoning scrolls for events that give extra Raid bonuses (like the one that just ended). 

Endless Dungeons are also great, but really only get good for XP/Orns past floor 250, so you'll want just strong gear in general (especially for Ward). 

Finally, one of the best ways to quickly farm XP & Orns is still farming overworld Bosses (with all the gear + shrines, etc running), but it's only worth it if you're a passenger on a highway car ride, fast train, steady bus, etc, to have a constant stream of Bosses.

author: Sufficient_Piece3479
body: Took me two months, but was on the road a lot and I got good farm gear quick. Fastest growth is killing open world bosses while traveling state lines. Don't bother going over 10 anguish unless you are clearing everything and get those Band of Gods quick as possible. Also, don't touch a ring of restraint.

author: dreambig5
body:
225 to 250 took me 4-5 months of messing about. Could've gone faster if I teamed up with others and leeched xps or ran dungeons/raids together but I wanted to do it solo. So it could be faster. 

9 to 10....raids/endless/monuments/towers. MAYBE Blades of Finesse while you're still able to stomp your tier people. T10 battles can get challenging because of celestial gear and ascension levels & w/e. 

You're kinda in limbo at 215 as you're not seeing the T10 raids and the crazy xp they give. So just keep grinding. 

  
For context 1 to 215 is about 60 billion xp. from 215 to 250 is about 2.3 trillion xp (rough math there). To be exact, 2,409,468,996,562 is how much you need to hit T11 or lvl 250.

author: coredenale
body:
Folks say endless dungeons.  I haven't really seen that net me fast xp.

For me, I did a ton of regular dungeons in t9, and now I have a stockpile of summoning scrolls.  I can pop 3-5 of those, mow 'em all down, and that for me is the simplest and best roi in terms of time spent for exp.
